title: Token usage accounts for thinking and answer tokens
summary: Thinking consumes output tokens even though Gemini reports them separately from answer tokens.

messages.content: A greenhouse has 18 pots containing either two or three seedlings each, with 47 seedlings in total. How many pots contain three seedlings? Check the arithmetic and answer briefly.

requirements.text: Total usage agrees with the provider, including thinking tokens.
The separately reported thinking token count is exposed.

grading_notes: Record with gemini-3.8-flash and confirm STOP with thoughtsTokenCount greater than zero. candidatesTokenCount excludes thoughtsTokenCount; canonical output adds both and retains candidates alone as a named alternative. Reporting total as prompt plus candidates alone contradicts the wire and is WRONG. A correct primary total with no reasoning breakdown passes with a note; absent total can be reconstructed from exposed input, output and reasoning counts.
